sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, the United States experienced a refugee crisis.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，美国经历了一场难民危机。

sentences.en: Thousands of Central Americans were fleeing brutal civil wars in El Salvador and Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的中美洲人为了逃离萨尔瓦多和危地马拉残酷的内战而背井离乡。

sentences.en: They were traveling north through Mexico and crossing the border into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们一路向北穿过墨西哥，越过边境进入美国。

sentences.en: We covered this history on the show last week.
sentences.zh: 我们在上周的节目中报道过这段历史。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard that episode yet,
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过那一集，

sentences.en: go listen now.
sentences.zh: 现在就去听听吧。

sentences.en: This is part two.
sentences.zh: 这是第二部分。

sentences.en: In response to this mass migration, a network of churches across the country
sentences.zh: 为了应对这场大规模移民潮，全国各地的教会网络

sentences.en: declared themselves sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: 宣布自己为“庇护所”。

sentences.en: That's producer Delaney Hall.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人德莱尼·霍尔。

sentences.en: In defiance of federal policy, some of these churches helped smuggle Central Americans across
sentences.zh: 为了反抗联邦政策，其中一些教会协助中美洲人偷渡

sentences.en: the border and offered shelter to people who were threatened with deportation.
sentences.zh: 越过边境，并为那些面临驱逐出境威胁的人提供庇护。

sentences.en: And most of the churches did this publicly, without trying to hide what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数教会都是公开这样做的，并没有试图掩盖他们的行为。

sentences.en: By the mid-1980s, the sanctuary movement had become very visible and also very controversial.
sentences.zh: 到了80年代中期，“庇护运动”已经变得非常引人注目，同时也极具争议。

sentences.en: Here's a report that aired on NBC around that time.
sentences.zh: 以下是当时美国全国广播公司（NBC）播出的一篇报道。

sentences.en: In the eyes of the congregation at St. Mary's Church, they are heroes.
sentences.zh: 在圣玛丽教堂的会众眼中，他们是英雄。

sentences.en: In the eyes of the federal government, they are criminals who smuggle aliens into this country
sentences.zh: 但在联邦政府眼中，他们是走私外籍人员进入该国的罪犯，

sentences.en: illegally.
sentences.zh: 是非法的。

sentences.en: The government didn't like that churches were openly defying immigration law in harboring
sentences.zh: 政府不喜欢教会公开无视移民法，窝藏

sentences.en: undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 无证移民的行为。

sentences.en: The Immigration and Naturalization Service, now known as Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
sentences.zh: 移民归化局（现称为移民及海关执法局，

sentences.en: or ICE, contended that many of these people didn't have legitimate asylum claiMs.
sentences.zh: 简称ICE）认为，这些人中许多并没有合法的庇护申请理由。

sentences.en: The agency's stance was that many of these migrants had come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该机构的立场是，这些移民中有许多来到美国

sentences.en: to find jobs,
sentences.zh: 是为了找工作，

sentences.en: not because they feared political persecution.
sentences.zh: 而不是因为他们害怕政治迫害。

sentences.en: A refugee from El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 一位来自萨尔瓦多的难民。

sentences.en: The administration contends he and others like him have come here for economic reasons.
sentences.zh: 政府坚称他和像他一样的人来这里是出于经济原因。

sentences.en: But the young man listed other reasons for fleeing his homeland.
sentences.zh: 但这位年轻人列举了逃离祖国的其他原因。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government found itself in a tough situation.
sentences.zh: 政府发现自己陷入了困境。

sentences.en: They could allow the churches to continue openly disregarding the law, or they could launch an
sentences.zh: 他们要么允许教会继续公开无视法律，要么对这场运动展开

sentences.en: investigation into the movement and risk public disapproval by targeting sympathetic church
sentences.zh: 调查，并冒着针对同情教会的

sentences.en: workers.
sentences.zh: 工作人员而引发公众不满的风险。

sentences.en: In 1984, the government launched an investigation into the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 1984年，政府对庇护运动展开了调查。

sentences.en: They called it Operation Sojourner, a biblical term for traveler or wanderer.
sentences.zh: 他们将其命名为“旅人行动”（Operation Sojourner），这是一个意为旅行者或流浪者的圣经术语。

sentences.en: The goal was to collect enough evidence to indict the leaders of the movement and to stop churches
sentences.zh: 其目标是收集足够的证据来起诉运动的领导人，并阻止教会

sentences.en: from sheltering migrants.
sentences.zh: 庇护移民。

sentences.en: The investigation would eventually raise big questions about the freedom of religion and
sentences.zh: 这项调查最终引发了关于宗教自由以及

sentences.en: the right of churches to declare themselves protected spaces, free from government intrusion.
sentences.zh: 教会是否有权宣布自己为受保护空间、免受政府侵扰的重大质疑。

sentences.en: This is an issue that's playing out in the news again today, as churches and other institutions
sentences.zh: 这个问题在今天的新闻中再次上演，因为教会和其他机构

sentences.en: anticipate large-scale deportations under President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 正在为唐纳德·特朗普总统任期内可能发生的大规模驱逐行动做准备。

sentences.en: On day one, I'm going to begin swiftly removing criminal, illegal immigrants from this country.
sentences.zh: 上任第一天，我就要开始迅速将犯罪的非法移民从这个国家清除出去。

sentences.en: Donald Trump's a pledge.
sentences.zh: 这是唐纳德·特朗普的承诺。

sentences.en: Demonstrators outside the immigration office in Colorado, supporting a mother of four from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多州移民局外的示威者，支持一位来自墨西哥的四孩母亲。

sentences.en: Jeanette Vizcarra.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·维兹卡拉。

sentences.en: Currently, in 2017, many churches are starting to shelter undocumented immigrants once again.
sentences.zh: 目前，在2017年，许多教会再次开始庇护无证移民。

sentences.en: In this episode, we're going to look back at what happened in the 1980s, the last time
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，我们将回顾20世纪80年代发生的事情，那是上一次

sentences.en: a big confrontation happened between the federal government and sanctuary churches.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府与庇护教会之间发生重大对抗的时候。

sentences.en: In 1984, shortly after the government launched its investigation, a couple of new volunteers approached
sentences.zh: 1984年，在政府展开调查后不久，几名新志愿者接触了

sentences.en: members of the sanctuary movement, asking if they could get involved.
sentences.zh: 庇护运动的成员，询问他们是否可以参与其中。

sentences.en: Their names were Jesus Cruz and Solomon Graham.
sentences.zh: 他们的名字是赫苏斯·克鲁兹和所罗门·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: I thought, they don't fit the usual sanctuary volunteer profile, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，他们看起来不像通常的庇护志愿者，对吧？

sentences.en: They look a little tough and a little too experienced on the border for the average volunteer we're getting.
sentences.zh: 对于我们通常招募的志愿者来说，他们看起来有点强悍，而且在边境的经验太丰富了。

sentences.en: This is Reverend John Fyfe.
sentences.zh: 这是约翰·法伊夫牧师。

sentences.en: Back in the 1980s, he was the pastor at Southside Presbyterian Church in Tucson, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 在80年代，他是亚利桑那州图森市南区长老会教堂的牧师。

sentences.en: He helped found the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 他帮助创立了庇护运动。

sentences.en: And Fyfe said that even though Cruz and Graham seemed a little different somehow,
sentences.zh: 法伊夫说，尽管克鲁兹和格雷厄姆看起来有些不同，

sentences.en: it was his policy to welcome all who said they wanted to help.
sentences.zh: 但他的原则是欢迎所有说想要帮忙的人。

sentences.en: They had crucifixes around their necks.
sentences.zh: 他们脖子上戴着十字架。

sentences.en: And they presented themselves as folks who'd heard about the sanctuary movement and wanted to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得像是听说过庇护运动并想参与其中的人。

sentences.en: So we welcomed them and included them in.
sentences.zh: 所以我们欢迎他们并让他们加入了。

sentences.en: Cruz and Graham began attending meetings and helping transport Central American migrants through the sanctuary network.
sentences.zh: 克鲁兹和格雷厄姆开始参加会议，并帮助通过庇护网络运送中美洲移民。

sentences.en: They would drive folks from Tucson to Phoenix or from Phoenix to Albuquerque or from Phoenix to L.A.
sentences.zh: 他们会开车把人从图森送到凤凰城，或者从凤凰城送到阿尔伯克基，或者从凤凰城送到洛杉矶。

sentences.en: So they would drive legs on the Underground Railroad.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会负责“地下铁路”的某些路段。

sentences.en: But as it would turn out, Cruz and Graham were not ordinary volunteers.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，克鲁兹和格雷厄姆并不是普通的志愿者。

sentences.en: They were undercover informants.
sentences.zh: 他们是卧底线人。

sentences.en: The government had hired them to infiltrate the movement and gather evidence.
sentences.zh: 政府雇佣他们渗透到运动中并收集证据。

sentences.en: Cruz and Graham were both former smugglers.
sentences.zh: 克鲁兹和格雷厄姆都是前走私犯。

sentences.en: They'd worked on the border as guides, bringing people into the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 他们曾在边境担任向导，非法将人带入该国。

sentences.en: Then they'd been caught by immigration.
sentences.zh: 后来他们被移民局抓住了。

sentences.en: And they'd reached an agreement that if they would infiltrate us and inform the government about what we were doing,
sentences.zh: 他们达成了一项协议：如果他们渗透到我们内部并向政府通报我们的所作所为，

sentences.en: that they would not only pay them, but drop the charges against them.
sentences.zh: 政府不仅会付钱给他们，还会撤销对他们的指控。

sentences.en: The INS had decided to investigate the sanctuary movement using the same tactics they might use against any criminal smuggling enterprise.
sentences.zh: 移民归化局决定使用他们可能对付任何犯罪走私企业相同的策略来调查庇护运动。

sentences.en: The agency wasn't swayed by the religious motivations of people like Reverend Fyfe.
sentences.zh: 该机构并没有被像法伊夫牧师这样的人的宗教动机所动摇。

sentences.en: Here's Alan Nelson, the then commissioner of INS, speaking with ABC in 1985.
sentences.zh: 这是时任移民归化局局长的艾伦·尼尔森，1985年接受美国广播公司（ABC）采访时的讲话。

sentences.en: If you and I are meeting in a church building to plan to rob a bank and open with a prayer and close with a prayer,
sentences.zh: 如果你和我正在教堂里开会策划抢劫银行，并以祈祷开始、以祈祷结束，

sentences.en: I don't think many people would say this is a church service that should be protected.
sentences.zh: 我不认为会有多少人会说这是一个应该受到保护的教会仪式。

sentences.en: They have the right to think what they want.
sentences.zh: 他们有权想他们想的事。

sentences.en: Anybody does.
sentences.zh: 任何人都有。

sentences.en: That doesn't exclude them from obeying the laws of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但这并不排除他们必须遵守美国法律。

sentences.en: This is Ruthann Myers.
sentences.zh: 这是鲁珊·迈尔斯。

sentences.en: She became the INS district director for Arizona in 1984.
sentences.zh: 她于1984年成为亚利桑那州移民归化局的地区主管。

sentences.en: She didn't oversee the investigation into the sanctuary movement,
sentences.zh: 她并没有监督对庇护运动的调查，

sentences.en: but she was briefed on it when she arrived at the Phoenix office.
sentences.zh: 但她在到达凤凰城办公室时听取了相关简报。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was totally surprised.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全感到惊讶。

sentences.en: In my experience, I had no knowledge before of a church breaking the law and harboring illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，我以前从未听说过有教会触犯法律并窝藏非法外籍人员。

sentences.en: Smuggling and harboring.
sentences.zh: 走私和窝藏。

sentences.en: Myers says the case was pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 迈尔斯说这个案子非常简单直接。

sentences.en: These people were breaking the law, the law of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些人是在触犯法律，触犯美国的法律。

sentences.en: I'm in favor of, excuse me, legal immigration, but not illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 我支持，抱歉，合法移民，但不支持非法移民。

sentences.en: I think we have the right to have our laws and to enforce them and decide who comes into this country and who doesn't.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们有权制定法律并执行法律，决定谁能进入这个国家，谁不能。

sentences.en: Cruz and Graham, along with a couple of other government agents, spent 10 months undercover, gathering evidence against the sanctuary workers.
sentences.zh: 克鲁兹和格雷厄姆以及其他几名政府特工进行了10个月的卧底，收集针对庇护工作者的证据。

sentences.en: Their methods would eventually come under public scrutiny, because they hadn't just infiltrated the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 他们的方法最终受到了公众的审视，因为他们不仅渗透了庇护运动，

sentences.en: They were also secretly recording meetings, conversations, and in some cases, church services.
sentences.zh: 他们还在秘密录制会议、谈话，在某些情况下，甚至录制了教堂礼拜。

sentences.en: These undercover methods struck some people as offensive and overreaching.
sentences.zh: 这些卧底手段让一些人感到冒犯和越权。

sentences.en: Here's Anthony Lewis, then a professor at Harvard Law School, speaking to ABC News in 1985.
sentences.zh: 这是时任哈佛法学院教授的安东尼·刘易斯，1985年接受ABC新闻采访时的讲话。

sentences.en: The state was infiltrating and secretly surveilling churches, in a country where the separation of church and state is a deeply held ideal.
sentences.zh: 在一个政教分离被视为深层理想的国家，国家竟然在渗透和秘密监视教会。

sentences.en: We reached out to two agents who were involved with the case,
sentences.zh: 我们联系了参与此案的两名特工，

sentences.en: and both declined to speak to us.
sentences.zh: 他们都拒绝与我们交谈。

sentences.en: The people overseeing the investigation at INS thought these methods were justified.
sentences.zh: 移民归化局负责监督调查的人认为这些方法是合理的。

sentences.en: They saw the movement as more political than religious.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这场运动的政治色彩多于宗教色彩。

sentences.en: Yes, there were many that thought it was under the guise of the church.
sentences.zh: 是的，有很多人认为这是打着教会的幌子。

sentences.en: Meaning the sanctuary workers were using religion as a cover to push a political agenda and undermine immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 意思是庇护工作者利用宗教作为掩护，来推动政治议程并破坏移民法。

sentences.en: And it's true that some sanctuary volunteers were vocally critical of the American policy in Central America.
sentences.zh: 确实，一些庇护志愿者公开批评美国在中美洲的政策。

sentences.en: Some expressed support for the left-wing movements developing there.
sentences.zh: 一些人表达了对当地正在发展的左翼运动的支持。

sentences.en: In fact, there was a divide within the movement itself about whether their work should be motivated primarily by humanitarian concerns or political ones.
sentences.zh: 事实上，运动内部对于他们的工作应该主要是出于人道主义关怀还是政治关怀存在分歧。

sentences.en: That debate got to the point where we decided to have a gathering and try to resolve it.
sentences.zh: 那场辩论激烈到我们决定举行一次聚会，试图解决它。

sentences.en: But two weeks before that meeting was supposed to happen, the government indicted 16 of the sanctuary workers in Tucson, including Reverend Fyfe.
sentences.zh: 但在那次会议召开前两周，政府起诉了图森市的16名庇护工作者，其中包括法伊夫牧师。

sentences.en: On January 14, 1985, federal agents swept down, arresting 63 Guatemalan and Salvadoran refugees across the United States,
sentences.zh: 1985年1月14日，联邦特工展开突袭，在全美逮捕了63名危地马拉和萨尔瓦多难民，

sentences.en: and handing out indictments to 16 leaders of the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 并向庇护运动的16名领导人发出了起诉书。

sentences.en: That morning, Reverend Fyfe was sleeping when he heard someone banging on his front door.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，法伊夫牧师正在睡觉，听到有人在敲他的前门。

sentences.en: And so I got up and I went to the door and there were two Border Patrol agents there.
sentences.zh: 于是我起床走到门口，那里站着两名边境巡逻队特工。

sentences.en: His immediate concern was for the refugees that were staying at Southside Presbyterian Church, right across the street from his house.
sentences.zh: 他当时最担心的是住在马路对面南区长老会教堂里的难民。

sentences.en: The only thought that occurred to me was, I got all these vulnerable people over in the church.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里闪过的唯一念头是，教堂里还有那么多脆弱的人。

sentences.en: I need to keep these guys occupied.
sentences.zh: 我得想办法拖住这些人。

sentences.en: So I invited him in, made coffee, stalled every way I could.
sentences.zh: 所以我邀请他们进来，煮了咖啡，用尽一切办法拖延时间。

sentences.en: He read through the entire indictment the officers had handed him, trying to buy some time.
sentences.zh: 他读完了警官递给他的整份起诉书，试图争取一些时间。

sentences.en: My charges were pretty clear and they were pretty typical of everyone.
sentences.zh: 对我的指控非常明确，而且对每个人来说都很典型。

sentences.en: They were a number of counts of conspiracy to violate federal law, harboring illegal aliens, transporting illegal aliens, and aiding and abetting illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 其中包括多项共谋违反联邦法律、窝藏非法外籍人员、运送非法外籍人员以及协助和教唆非法外籍人员的罪名。

sentences.en: And everyone had different counts under each of those categories.
sentences.zh: 每个人在这些类别下都有不同的指控项。

sentences.en: Eventually, the Border Patrol agents went on their way, and Reverend Fyfe and the other leaders of the sanctuary movement were left with a daunting situation.
sentences.zh: 最终，边境巡逻队特工离开了，法伊夫牧师和庇护运动的其他领导人陷入了严峻的境地。

sentences.en: They faced an impending, high-profile trial in which they'd be facing off with the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他们面临着一场即将到来的、备受瞩目的审判，他们将与联邦政府对簿公堂。

sentences.en: And the charges against them were serious.
sentences.zh: 而且对他们的指控非常严重。

sentences.en: If convicted, they could spend years in prison.
sentences.zh: 如果罪名成立，他们可能会在监狱里度过多年。

sentences.en: They got to work assembling a team of lawyers to defend them.
sentences.zh: 他们开始着手组建律师团队为自己辩护。

sentences.en: So there's two bases, as I see it, for sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，庇护有两个基础。

sentences.en: It's very simple, really.
sentences.zh: 其实很简单。

sentences.en: This is James Brosnahan, one of the defense lawyers.
sentences.zh: 这是辩护律师之一詹姆斯·布罗斯纳汉。

sentences.en: The first is religion, and many churches, many religions, have as a distinct imperative that you are to assist people who are on the road and who are fleeing some form of violence,
sentences.zh: 首先是宗教，许多教会、许多宗教都有一个明确的准则，即你必须帮助那些在路上逃离某种形式暴力、

sentences.en: oppression.
sentences.zh: 压迫的人。

sentences.en: It's the teaching of Jesus.
sentences.zh: 这是耶稣的教导。

sentences.en: The defense thought there was an argument to be made, that the sanctuary workers were just acting in accordance with their faith.
sentences.zh: 辩方认为可以提出一个论点，即庇护工作者只是在按照他们的信仰行事。

sentences.en: Not only that,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，

sentences.en: the lawyers believed the religious rights of the sanctuary workers had been violated by the government agents who'd infiltrated their churches and made secret recordings.
sentences.zh: 律师们认为，政府特工渗透进他们的教堂并进行秘密录音，侵犯了庇护工作者的宗教权利。

sentences.en: And that's intimidation of people who are pursuing their Bible studies in a church.
sentences.zh: 那是对在教堂里研读圣经的人的恐吓。

sentences.en: The second part of the defense's argument had to do with asylum law.
sentences.zh: 辩方论点的第二部分与庇护法有关。

sentences.en: The law provides that when a person shows up at the border and they are fleeing certain specific kinds of oppression or violence, they have a right to come in.
sentences.zh: 法律规定，当一个人出现在边境并逃离某些特定的压迫或暴力时，他们有权进入。

sentences.en: And when that is true and that can be established in an immigration court, that person is entitled to stay in the United States.
sentences.zh: 当事实确实如此，并且可以在移民法庭上得到证实，那个人就有权留在美国。

sentences.en: That's asylum.
sentences.zh: 这就是庇护。

sentences.en: As the defense team researched the laws, they started to believe that their clients hadn't really violated the law at all.
sentences.zh: 随着辩护团队研究法律，他们开始相信他们的当事人并没有真正违反法律。

sentences.en: They thought the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们认为违反法律的是美国

sentences.en: government had.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: I did research both how the United States government was handling asylum applications from people from Central America, and I also researched international law.
sentences.zh: 我研究了美国政府如何处理来自中美洲人的庇护申请，我也研究了国际法。

sentences.en: This is A.
sentences.zh: 这是A.

sentences.en: Bates Butler III, another lawyer for the sanctuary volunteers.
sentences.zh: 贝茨·巴特勒三世，另一位为庇护志愿者辩护的律师。

sentences.en: And I was appalled by what I discovered about how the United States government was systematically, it seemed, denying asylum applications from Central America.
sentences.zh: 我对自己发现的美国政府似乎在系统性地拒绝来自中美洲的庇护申请感到震惊。

sentences.en: This was all happening in the context of a major shift in U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在美国

sentences.en: refugee policy.
sentences.zh: 难民政策发生重大转变的背景下。

sentences.en: Before 1980, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 1980年以前，美国

sentences.en: approach to taking in refugees had been expressly political.
sentences.zh: 接收难民的方式带有明显的政治色彩。

sentences.en: It gave preference to refugees fleeing communist countries and countries in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 它优先考虑那些逃离共产主义国家和中东国家的难民。

sentences.en: In 1980, President Carter signed the Refugee Act into law.
sentences.zh: 1980年，卡特总统签署了《难民法》并使其生效。

sentences.en: The law was supposed to create a fairer system by adopting a more humanitarian, non-ideological definition of a refugee.
sentences.zh: 该法案旨在通过采用更人道、非意识形态的难民定义来建立一个更公平的体系。

sentences.en: It used the criteria developed by the United Nations, which identified a refugee as anyone with a well-founded fear of persecution based on race, religion, nationality,
sentences.zh: 它使用了联合国制定的标准，将难民定义为任何因种族、宗教、国籍、

sentences.en: social group, or political opinion.
sentences.zh: 社会群体或政治观点而有充分理由担心受到迫害的人。

sentences.en: Even though these new criteria were in place when Reagan came into office, the lawyers for the sanctuary workers believed the government was not following its own law.
sentences.zh: 尽管里根上任时这些新标准已经到位，但庇护工作者的律师们认为政府并没有遵守自己的法律。

sentences.en: They thought INS was turning away large numbers of El Salvadorans and Guatemalans who should have qualified as political refugees.
sentences.zh: 他们认为移民局（INS）拒绝了大量本应有资格成为政治难民的萨尔瓦多人和危地马拉人。

sentences.en: Butler had been skeptical of the sanctuary movement when he first learned about it, but his research had changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 巴特勒最初听说庇护运动时曾持怀疑态度，但他的研究改变了他的想法。

sentences.en: And so I moved from a position of, well, this is all fine and dandy and this is the religious thing to do, but it's illegal.
sentences.zh: 所以我从那种认为“这虽然很好，是宗教上该做的事，但它是违法的”立场，

sentences.en: I moved from that position to it's lawful to help these people and it's the United States government that is violating the law.
sentences.zh: 转变为“帮助这些人是合法的，而违反法律的正是美国政府”的立场。

sentences.en: The defendants and their supporters marched to the federal building in Phoenix for the first round of arraignments this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，被告及其支持者游行前往凤凰城的联邦大楼，参加第一轮传讯。

sentences.en: The charges, transporting aliens illegally, harboring them, and conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 指控包括非法运送外籍人士、窝藏他们以及共谋罪。

sentences.en: Inside the courtroom, the defendants pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 在法庭内，被告均表示不认罪。

sentences.en: They were released without bail.
sentences.zh: 他们被无保释放。

sentences.en: Their trials were set for April 2nd.
sentences.zh: 他们的审判日期定于4月2日。

sentences.en: The sanctuary people say those trials will be a major test of religious freedoms in this country.
sentences.zh: 庇护运动人士表示，这些审判将是对这个国家宗教自由的一次重大考验。

sentences.en: After months of preparation, the defense team was feeling confident.
sentences.zh: 经过数月的准备，辩护团队感到很有信心。

sentences.en: They thought they had sympathetic clients, a good amount of public support, and compelling legal arguments.
sentences.zh: 他们认为自己有值得同情的当事人、大量的公众支持以及令人信服的法律论据。

sentences.en: Here's Reverend Fyfe again.
sentences.zh: 这是法伊夫牧师再次发言。

sentences.en: Our position was, oh, we welcome the opportunity to make that case in court.
sentences.zh: 我们的立场是，哦，我们欢迎有机会在法庭上提出这一主张。

sentences.en: And we think we're going to win in a slam dunk.
sentences.zh: 而且我们认为我们一定会大获全胜。

sentences.en: But then, very early on, the defense team faced a major setback.
sentences.zh: 但随后，辩护团队在很早阶段就遭遇了重大挫折。

sentences.en: The lead prosecutor for the government was a lawyer named Donald Reno Jr.
sentences.zh: 政府的首席检察官是一位名叫小唐纳德·雷诺的律师。

sentences.en: And one of his first moves was to file a series of motions, asking the federal judge who was hearing the case to limit the arguments the defense could make.
sentences.zh: 他的第一步行动之一就是提交了一系列动议，要求审理此案的联邦法官限制辩方可以提出的论点。

sentences.en: And then, the federal judge who was hearing our case ruled that we couldn't say anything in our defense during our trial about five subjects.
sentences.zh: 然后，审理我们案件的联邦法官裁定，在审判期间，我们不能就五个主题进行任何辩护。

sentences.en: United States refugee law, international refugee law, conditions in El Salvador, conditions in Guatemala, or our religious faith.
sentences.zh: 即美国难民法、国际难民法、萨尔瓦多的状况、危地马拉的状况，或者我们的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: So, that wiped out our entire legal position.
sentences.zh: 所以，这彻底摧毁了我们的整个法律立场。

sentences.en: I mean, what was left?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还剩下什么？

sentences.en: Nothing was left.
sentences.zh: 什么都没剩下。

sentences.en: And the way my attorney explained it was, well,
sentences.zh: 我的律师解释说，嗯，

sentences.en: federal judges in criminal prosecutions have enormous power to exclude evidence that they believe is not relevant to the charges that are being filed against the defendant.
sentences.zh: 联邦法官在刑事诉讼中拥有巨大的权力，可以排除他们认为与针对被告的指控无关的证据。

sentences.en: The judge had effectively reduced the case to its most basic level.
sentences.zh: 法官实际上将案件简化到了最基本的层面。

sentences.en: Had the sanctuary workers engaged in a conspiracy to smuggle and harbor undocumented people?
sentences.zh: 庇护工作者是否参与了走私和窝藏无证人员的共谋？

sentences.en: Yes or no?
sentences.zh: 是还是不是？

sentences.en: There was to be no discussion about context, history, or motivations.
sentences.zh: 关于背景、历史或动机，一概不得讨论。

sentences.en: One of the defendants was a man named Jim Corbett.
sentences.zh: 其中一名被告是一个名叫吉姆·科比特的人。

sentences.en: Along with Reverend Fife, he'd helped to found the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 他和法伊夫牧师一起帮助创立了庇护运动。

sentences.en: Corbett died in 2001, but in an archival interview, he described the situation that the defense team found itself in.
sentences.zh: 科比特于2001年去世，但在一次存档采访中，他描述了辩护团队所处的困境。

sentences.en: He said it was as if a man was driving late at night in freezing weather.
sentences.zh: 他说，这就像一个人在深夜寒冷的天气里开车。

sentences.en: His car breaks down, so he goes to a nearby house.
sentences.zh: 他的车坏了，所以他去了附近的一所房子。

sentences.en: And breaks in, and then is discovered, and brought to trial.
sentences.zh: 破门而入，然后被发现，并被送上法庭。

sentences.en: And the judge rules out any evidence that would indicate that it was 40 below.
sentences.zh: 而法官排除了任何能够表明当时气温是零下40度的证据。

sentences.en: His car had gone bad.
sentences.zh: 他的车坏了。

sentences.en: He had stopped, went to the only house in the area, and entered it.
sentences.zh: 他停下来，去了该地区唯一的房子，并进入了它。

sentences.en: Without understanding the context, Jim thought there was no way the jury could understand why the sanctuary workers had decided to shelter Central Americans.
sentences.zh: 如果不了解背景，吉姆认为陪审团根本无法理解为什么庇护工作者决定收容中美洲人。

sentences.en: Now, in terms of the necessity defense, we're talking about something very similar with people fleeing torture and murder in a very different context.
sentences.zh: 现在，就必要性辩护而言，我们谈论的是非常相似的情况，即人们在完全不同的背景下逃离酷刑和谋杀。

sentences.en: But to rule out the ability to refer to that necessity simply makes a mockery of the law.
sentences.zh: 但排除提及这种必要性的能力，简直是对法律的嘲弄。

sentences.en: The judge, named Earl Carroll, died in early February of 2017.
sentences.zh: 这位名叫厄尔·卡罗尔的法官于2017年2月初去世。

sentences.en: We requested an interview with prosecutor Donald Reno Jr., but he's still an active litigator for what's now known as Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我们曾请求采访检察官小唐纳德·雷诺，但他现在仍是移民及海关执法局（ICE）的现役诉讼律师。

sentences.en: The agency declined our request to speak with him.
sentences.zh: 该机构拒绝了我们与他交谈的请求。

sentences.en: But he was featured in a news report from 1985, and he described the sanctuary movement as, quote,
sentences.zh: 但他曾出现在1985年的一篇新闻报道中，他将庇护运动描述为，引用：

sentences.en: an alien smuggling conspiracy.
sentences.zh: “一个外籍人士走私阴谋”。

sentences.en: The defendants induced, encouraged, smuggled, transported, and harbored illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 被告诱导、鼓励、走私、运送并窝藏了非法外籍人士。

sentences.en: The government says that's not much different from drug smuggling.
sentences.zh: 政府称这与毒品走私没什么两样。

sentences.en: Over the next several months, the prosecution laid out its case against the sanctuary workers,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，检方陈述了针对庇护工作者的案件，

sentences.en: relying heavily on testimony from their undercover informants.
sentences.zh: 严重依赖其卧底线人的证词。

sentences.en: Reno characterized the sanctuary movement as a smuggling operation, pure and simple.
sentences.zh: 雷诺将庇护运动定性为纯粹的走私行动。

sentences.en: The defense team tried to undermine those accounts in cross-examination and to sneak in details about context and motivation when they could.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队试图在交叉询问中削弱这些陈述，并尽可能地塞入有关背景和动机的细节。

sentences.en: But in most ways, their hands were tied.
sentences.zh: 但在大多数方面，他们束手无策。

sentences.en: And when it came time for the defense to present their case, they declined to put anyone on the stand.
sentences.zh: 当辩方需要陈述案情时，他们拒绝让任何人出庭作证。

sentences.en: Sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 庇护运动。

sentences.en: Today, the defense rested without questioning a single witness.
sentences.zh: 今天，辩方在没有询问任何证人的情况下结束了辩护。

sentences.en: Jury deliberations could begin next week.
sentences.zh: 陪审团的审议可能会在下周开始。

sentences.en: It is alleged the sanctuary movement...
sentences.zh: 据称庇护运动……

sentences.en: For more than 48 hours, spread over nine days.
sentences.zh: 在九天的时间里，总共超过48小时。

sentences.en: On May 1st, 1986, 16 months after the indictments and more than six months since the start of the trial,
sentences.zh: 1986年5月1日，在起诉16个月后，距离审判开始已超过六个月，

sentences.en: the jury filed into the courtroom to read the verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团进入法庭宣读裁决。

sentences.en: Of the 11 sanctuary workers who went to trial, three were acquitted of all charges.
sentences.zh: 在受审的11名庇护工作者中，有3人被判所有指控不成立。

sentences.en: Eight were found guilty, including Reverend Fyfe, which hit Bates Butler, the lawyer, really hard.
sentences.zh: 8人被判有罪，其中包括法伊夫牧师，这对律师贝茨·巴特勒打击很大。

sentences.en: After the jury came in, I was so disgusted with the system that I had worked in for so long, I didn't want to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 陪审团裁决后，我对这个我工作了这么久的系统感到非常厌恶，我不想再成为它的一部分。

sentences.en: And we were so upset that our government and our court system had cast aside our clients with their moral positions
sentences.zh: 我们感到非常难过，因为我们的政府和法院系统抛弃了我们那些坚持道德立场的当事人，

sentences.en: and that we felt like the government and the courts were bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得政府和法院已经破产了。

sentences.en: The system was bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 这个系统已经破产了。

sentences.en: But the other defense lawyer, James Brosnahan, had known there were significant hurdles they needed to overcome.
sentences.zh: 但另一位辩护律师詹姆斯·布罗纳汉知道他们需要克服重大的障碍。

sentences.en: You know, juries are very good, but they come into the box with their own attitude.
sentences.zh: 你知道，陪审团很好，但他们带着自己的态度进入法庭。

sentences.en: And the attitude is people just can't come over the border.
sentences.zh: 这种态度就是人们不能就这样越过边境。

sentences.en: If you're going to do that, you've got to pay the price.
sentences.zh: 如果你要那样做，你就必须付出代价。

sentences.en: Ruth Ann Myers of the INS thought the verdict was fair.
sentences.zh: 移民局的露丝·安·迈尔斯认为裁决是公平的。

sentences.en: The people that worked in the sanctuary movement did not present those people to immigration offices.
sentences.zh: 在庇护运动中工作的人并没有把这些人带到移民局办公室。

sentences.en: They smuggled them into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们把他们走私进了美国。

sentences.en: They gave them, quote, sanctuary in their churches.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他们，引用，“在教堂里的庇护”。

sentences.en: They did not follow the law.
sentences.zh: 他们没有遵守法律。

sentences.en: Next came the sentencing by the judge.
sentences.zh: 接下来是法官的量刑。

sentences.en: We really were worried that the judge was going to put him in prison.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很担心法官会把他关进监狱。

sentences.en: My attorney told me, take a toothbrush in your hip pocket when you go to sentencing because they want you bad.
sentences.zh: 我的律师告诉我，去听判决时在裤兜里带上一把牙刷，因为他们想要严惩你。

sentences.en: So I had made arrangements with the congregation and with my family and everything expecting to go to prison.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经和会众、家人以及一切做好了安排，准备去坐牢。

sentences.en: And much to our astonishment, he sentenced all of us who were convicted to five years probation.
sentences.zh: 令我们大吃一惊的是，他判处我们所有被定罪的人五年缓刑。

sentences.en: The judge gave them relatively lenient sentences, considering they'd been convicted of, in some cases, felonies.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们被判犯有重罪（在某些情况下），法官给出的判决相对宽大。

sentences.en: So we were relieved at that point.
sentences.zh: 所以在那一刻我们松了一口气。

sentences.en: I think, I don't know what he thought, but I thought that if he gave these nice people a jail term, it would be awful public opinion on that.
sentences.zh: 我想，我不知道他在想什么，但我认为如果他给这些好人判刑，那将会在公众舆论中造成恶劣影响。

sentences.en: And I think he had some sense that that might be true.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他意识到这可能是真的。

sentences.en: Many of the sanctuary workers, including Reverend Fyfe, went back to their communities and continued their work in the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 许多庇护工作者，包括法伊夫牧师，回到了他们的社区，继续他们在庇护运动中的工作。

sentences.en: Churches continued sheltering people.
sentences.zh: 教堂继续收容人们。

sentences.en: Volunteers continued helping people across the border.
sentences.zh: 志愿者继续帮助人们越过边境。

sentences.en: Many of the sanctuary volunteers had made clear in their closing arguments in the trial that they wouldn't stop doing the work.
sentences.zh: 许多庇护志愿者在审判的结案陈词中明确表示，他们不会停止这项工作。

sentences.en: The government may have sentenced John Fyfe and seven other sanctuary activists, but it has hardly silenced them nor stopped them from a cross-country crusade.
sentences.zh: 政府可能已经判处了约翰·法伊夫和其他七名庇护活动家，但这并没有让他们沉默，也没有阻止他们进行全国性的运动。

sentences.en: And at that point, did the government just back off?
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，政府是否就退缩了？

sentences.en: I mean, they must have known that you were continuing to do exactly what they'd just tried you for.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们一定知道你们在继续做他们刚刚审判你们的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They backed off us here in Tucson.
sentences.zh: 他们在图森这里退缩了。

sentences.en: But they tried one more trial.
sentences.zh: 但他们又进行了一次审判。

sentences.en: In New Mexico, the government charged a man and a woman who were part of the sanctuary movement for transporting undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 在新墨西哥州，政府指控一名参与庇护运动的男子和一名女子运送无证移民。

sentences.en: And the jury in that case found them not guilty.
sentences.zh: 而那起案件的陪审团裁定他们无罪。

sentences.en: And at that point, we knew that the movement had grown to the point where juries would no longer convict sanctuary workers.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我们知道运动已经发展到陪审团不再会给庇护工作者定罪的地步了。

sentences.en: Not long after the criminal trial had ended, a group of churches and refugee rights organizations filed a class-action lawsuit against the government.
sentences.zh: 刑事审判结束后不久，一群教堂和难民权利组织对政府提起了集体诉讼。

sentences.en: They alleged, among other things, that the government had engaged in discriminatory treatment of asylum claims made by Guatemalans and Salvadorans.
sentences.zh: 他们指控政府在处理危地马拉人和萨尔瓦多人的庇护申请时存在歧视性待遇等问题。

sentences.en: In 1990, the government settled the lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 1990年，政府与原告达成和解。

sentences.en: They agreed to give everyone who was here without documents from those countries temporary protected status, work permits.
sentences.zh: 他们同意给予所有来自这些国家且没有证件的人临时保护身份和工作许可。

sentences.en: And they agreed to a whole series of reforms of the political asylum process.
sentences.zh: 他们还同意对政治庇护程序进行一系列改革。

sentences.en: So we essentially began to wind down the sanctuary movement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们基本上开始缩减庇护运动。

sentences.en: But even though the churches were slowing their work, the whole idea of sanctuary was spreading.
sentences.zh: 但尽管教堂的工作放缓了，庇护的整个理念却在传播。

sentences.en: College campuses, cities, counties, even whole states began to declare themselves sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: 大学校园、城市、县，甚至整个州都开始宣布自己为庇护所。

sentences.en: And not just for refugees fleeing persecution, but for undocumented people more broadly.
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了逃避迫害的难民，更是为了更广泛的无证人员。

sentences.en: This accelerated through the 1980s and has continued up to today.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在20世纪80年代加速发展，并一直持续到今天。

sentences.en: But what exactly sanctuary means varies from place to place.
sentences.zh: 但庇护的确切含义因地而异。

sentences.en: Anything you want.
sentences.zh: 任何你想要的含义。

sentences.en: That's part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: And each city is probably a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 而且每个城市可能都有一点不同。

sentences.en: Once again, lawyer James Brosnahan.
sentences.zh: 再次请出律师詹姆斯·布罗纳汉。

sentences.en: Usually the local authorities, police, sheriffs, will not assist in the deportation of undocumented people.
sentences.zh: 通常地方当局、警察、治安官不会协助驱逐无证人员。

sentences.en: In some places, police aren't allowed to inquire about a person's immigration status or to give that information to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 在一些地方，警察不允许询问一个人的移民身份，也不允许将该信息提供给联邦政府。

sentences.en: In other places, all residents are promised access to city services regardless of their immigration status.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，所有居民都被承诺无论其移民身份如何，都可以获得城市服务。

sentences.en: These policies can be set in law or they can just happen in practice.
sentences.zh: 这些政策可以写进法律，也可以只是在实践中执行。

sentences.en: President Donald Trump talked a lot about sanctuary cities during his campaign.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在竞选期间谈了很多关于庇护城市的问题。

sentences.en: And he's pointed to murders committed by undocumented immigrants as evidence that sanctuary cities should not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 他指出无证移民犯下的谋杀案，以此作为庇护城市不应存在的证据。

sentences.en: He's threatened to pull federal funding from cities that identify as sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: 他威胁要切断对那些自称为庇护城市的联邦资助。

sentences.en: And he's also promised to accelerate deportations.
sentences.zh: 他还承诺加快驱逐出境。

sentences.en: In response, churches are once again sheltering people.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，教堂再次开始收容人们。

sentences.en: I think a lot of congregations across the nation are struggling with what will it mean to be faithful to the mandates of our faith underneath this administration.
sentences.zh: 我认为全国各地的许多会众都在努力思考，在这个政府领导下，忠于我们信仰的使命意味着什么。

sentences.en: This is Allison Harrington.
sentences.zh: 这是艾莉森·哈林顿。

sentences.en: She's the current pastor of Southside Presbyterian in Tucson, the church where the sanctuary movement began in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 她是图森南区长老会的现任牧师，也就是20世纪80年代庇护运动开始的教堂。

sentences.en: She and her congregation provided sanctuary to a couple of people who were threatened with deportation during the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 她和她的会众在奥巴马政府期间为几名面临驱逐威胁的人提供了庇护。

sentences.en: They're now having conversations about whether that work will expand in the next few years.
sentences.zh: 他们现在正在讨论这项工作在未来几年是否会扩大。

sentences.en: I mean, I can't ignore the fact that my predecessor, John Fyfe, was indicted for doing the work that I'm doing right now and that he was looking at 10 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我无法忽视这样一个事实：我的前任约翰·法伊夫因做我现在正在做的工作而被起诉，并且面临10年的监禁。

sentences.en: I try not to think about that, but you can't ignore that.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不去想这件事，但你无法忽视它。

sentences.en: Since 2011, churches have had some protected status as sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: 自2011年以来，教堂作为庇护所获得了一些受保护的地位。

sentences.en: In that year, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, under President Obama, issued a memo.
sentences.zh: 那一年，在奥巴马总统领导下，移民及海关执法局发布了一份备忘录。

sentences.en: It's said that some sensitive locations require special consideration by immigration officers.
sentences.zh: 它指出一些敏感地点需要移民官员特别考虑。

sentences.en: The government has said we won't enter into those sensitive locations unless it's an extreme situation or we have higher levels of approval.
sentences.zh: 政府表示，除非是极端情况或我们有更高级别的批准，否则我们不会进入这些敏感地点。

sentences.en: And those sensitive locations are houses of worship, hospitals, and schools.
sentences.zh: 而这些敏感地点包括礼拜场所、医院和学校。

sentences.en: But that practice isn't codified into law and could easily change.
sentences.zh: 但这种做法并没有编入法律，很容易改变。

sentences.en: Recently, there have been reports of immigration agents targeting undocumented people in hospitals and schools.
sentences.zh: 最近有报道称，移民代理人在医院和学校针对无证人员进行抓捕。

sentences.en: Churches might also be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 教堂也可能变得脆弱。

sentences.en: That's going to have to be worked out through a number of institutional decisions as well as court decisions well into the future.
sentences.zh: 这需要在未来通过一系列机构决策以及法院判决来解决。

sentences.en: What's going to be the result five years from now?
sentences.zh: 五年后会是什么结果？

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: No one knows.
sentences.zh: 没人知道。
